name: Forced displacement
summary: OCHA counts over 323,000 displaced in South Kivu 6–9 Nov, the largest new event this month but below the 500,000 line
state: OCHA reported on 11 Nov that fighting between the Congolese army and FRN rebels displaced over 323,000 people in Kalehe and Kabare, South Kivu, between 6 and 9 Nov, most towards the Itebero health zone in North Kivu (Radio Okapi, 13 Nov). That is below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line, and Radio Okapi described a precarious calm in Bunyakiri on 13 Nov. UNHCR said on 10 Nov that about 64,000 people have fled northern Nigeria to Niger in 2026 (Reuters via Internazionale). Normal is kept.
for_you: Displaced families in eastern DR Congo need shelter, food and health care. Host areas in North Kivu and neighbouring countries are most exposed if fighting resumes and the count rises.
